lines.en: "So, I thought we could take the customer list. And we could..."
"You realize you're not actually talking to me, right?"
The new receptionist is also named Kelly, so Kelly Kapoor has decided to hover around
my desk so that she can run into Charles' office every time he calls for Kelly.
She thinks that if she says, "You wanted me," enough, he will, in fact, want her.
It's not the worst plan she's ever had.
"Okay, I'm gonna call you Kapoor, okay? And you, Hannon."
"If we're changing names, can I be Aaron? That's my middle name."
"Well, you know what my middle name is? Rajani Gonda, and I hate it! I hate it!"
"I thought Rajani Gonda was a boy's name."
"You know, there's a ghost in this office."
"A woman was murdered on this very floor in 1816. Hattie McGonagall. She was a prostitute."
"Oh, I mean, this whole place used to be a brothel. There was a tavern on the ground floor."
"Yeah, isn't it? She was bludgeoned to death by the business end of a riding crop."
"Oh, it's gruesome. They say she walks these hallways. If you ever feel a tapping on your shoulder, that could be Hattie begging for her life. And it could mean that you're next."
"Listen, when I saw you talking to Aaron earlier, I noticed that your pupils dilated and your skin flushed, and I'm assuming a little bit of blood rushed into your penis."
"Well, a little bit of blood rushed into mine as well, so where does that leave us?"
"The last thing I want to do is step on your bunk, man."
"And I yours, so I will cede her to you."
"Look, you've been here longer, and besides, I'm a better winged man than I am a boyfriend."
I just want you and I to hang out.
